mainEntity.name: What's included in the Pick N Mix Subscription

acceptedAnswer.text: 15% off courses, workshops and 1-to-1 lessons for 12 months (residential workshops capped at 10%; bundles count at their bundle price) 4 quarterly 1-2-1 Zoom reviews of 60 minutes each 12 months' Photography Academy, free (worth £79): 200+ learning resources, 30 exams, 5 accreditation levels and your personal dashboard First refusal on new residential workshop dates Pay once, up-front : by card on this page or by bank transfer

Choose your plan value from the dropdown, from £1,200, or choose more if you like. You pay once, up-front, and your full plan value is available straight away. Alan will send you a link to book your first review in his diary, and you will then receive a confirmation email with a Zoom link. Book courses, workshops and lessons online using your plan code: your discount is applied and the cost comes off your balance. You can top up your balance at any time with a one-off payment. Any unused balance can be used up to 3 months after your plan ends; after that it is forfeited. Plans are non-refundable and non-cancellable.
Pay on this page, or by bank transfer to: Halifax · Sort code 11 00 01 · Account 08281711 See example plans and full details on the Pick n Mix: Your first year page.
